stories.headline: Bills' Bison Goes Down Hard, Buffalo Backfield of Pass-Catchers Shakes Loose
stories.read: DJ Moore dove for paydirt Thursday night against Detroit and landed on that left shoulder wrong, headed for out just past halftime with docs whisperin' clavicle trouble. Fresh off a 100-yard debut in a Bills uniform, that's a rough spill for a fella who just struck gold. But every cloud drops rain on somebody's crop: Khalil Shakir and Keon Coleman just saw their cut of the throws jump overnight. Go stake that claim on the waiver wire before the rest of the outfit wakes up.

stories.headline: Jaguars Ship Bigsby to Philly, Tuten Left Holdin' the Reins in Duval
stories.read: Jacksonville traded Tank Bigsby off to the Eagles for a couple draft picks, and pardner, that's a dry well turned into a gold mine for somebody else. Bhayshul Tuten's already rode 83 carries for 307 yards and five scores this year, and now he's the lone spare horse behind Travis Etienne with nobody else eatin' into that haul. Bigsby, meanwhile, rides into Philly as nothin' more than the handcuff behind Saquon Barkley. Tuten's your diamond in the rough this week — don't let the rest of the saloon beat you to him.

stories.headline: Pittman's Foot Keeps Him Off the Range, Colts' Open Territory Widens
stories.read: Michael Pittman couldn't even saddle up for the open portion of Friday's practice, gettin' downgraded from limited to a no-show after a sore foot, and that's got him trendin' toward a Sunday spent on the porch. When the Colts' top hand sits, the cut of throws don't disappear, it just gets redistributed. Josh Downs and Alec Pierce-type receivers across the league in similar spots are worth a look on the open range this week. Watch that practice report Saturday before you lock your lineup, though — foot injuries can turn on a dime.
